# hibira_app (Data Source)

Reads an existing Hibira app. The secret is never returned; manage the app with `hibira_app` to get it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hibira_app" "existing" {
  id = "app_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The app ID.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) The allowed web origins.
- `client_events` (Boolean) Whether client events are on.
- `cluster` (String) The app's region.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app is enabled.
- `host` (String) The WebSocket host clients connect to.
- `key` (String) The app key.
- `name` (String) The app's name.
- `plan` (String) The account plan.
- `subscription_count` (Boolean) Whether subscription count events are on.
